hook.name: DoodStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Dood strategy tokens that collects a swap fee in afterSwap as a positive delta, distributes it 80/20 between two recipients (80% to the DoodStrategy contract and 20% to the team wallet), converts token-denominated fees to ETH via a nested pool swap, and toggles an anti-MEV flag on the strategy token contract during swaps.
